q.q: What is 35% of 240?
An article costs ₹500. It is sold at 12% profit. What is the selling price?
q.e: Profit = 12% of 500 = 60. Selling price = 500 + 60 = ₹560.

q.q: What is the average of the first 10 natural numbers?
Two numbers are in the ratio 2 : 3 and their difference is 15. What is the larger number?
q.e: Difference of parts = 3 − 2 = 1 part = 15. Larger = 3 × 15 = 45.

q.q: Simple interest on ₹2000 at 5% per year for 4 years is:
Find the next number: 1, 4, 9, 16, 25, ?
q.e: These are squares: 1², 2², 3², 4², 5². Next is 6² = 36.

q.q: Find the odd one out: Square, Triangle, Circle, Cube
q.e: Square, triangle and circle are flat (2D) shapes. A cube is a solid (3D) shape.

q.q: If PEN is written as QFO, how is INK written?
q.e: Each letter moves 1 step forward: P→Q, E→F, N→O. So I→J, N→O, K→L = JOL.

q.q: Pointing to a boy, Ria says, "He is the son of my mother's only son." How is the boy related to Ria?
q.e: Ria's mother's only son is Ria's brother. The son of her brother is her nephew.

q.q: Today is Monday. What day will it be after 10 days?
q.e: 10 days = 1 week + 3 days. Monday + 3 days = Thursday.

q.q: Choose the synonym of HUGE.
q.e: Huge means very big, the same as enormous.

q.q: Choose the antonym of EXPAND.
q.e: Expand means become bigger. The opposite is contract (become smaller).

q.q: Fill in the blank: He has been living here ___ 2015.
q.e: Use 'since' with a point of time (2015). Use 'for' with a length of time (for 10 years).

q.q: Fill in the blank: She is ___ honest girl.
q.e: 'Honest' starts with a vowel sound (the h is silent), so we use 'an'.

q.q: What does the idiom "break the ice" mean?
o: To start a friendly talk in a quiet or awkward situation
q.e: To break the ice means to start a conversation and make people feel relaxed.

q.q: Who is known as the Father of the Indian Constitution?
q.e: Dr B. R. Ambedkar chaired the Drafting Committee of the Constitution.

q.q: Which is the largest ocean in the world?
q.e: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean.

q.q: The Hornbill Festival is celebrated in which state?
q.e: The Hornbill Festival is held in Nagaland every December.

q.q: What is the SI unit of force?
q.e: Force is measured in newton (N). Joule = energy, watt = power, pascal = pressure.

q.q: Kuchipudi is a classical dance of which state?
q.e: Kuchipudi comes from Andhra Pradesh. Kathakali and Mohiniyattam are from Kerala.
